subject: Application for Software Developer (Backend) - Bengaluru
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Developer (Backend) position at Nexora's Bengaluru office, which I came across on LinkedIn last week.

I have 3.5 years of experience building REST APIs in Java (Spring Boot) and Python at Mindcrest Technologies, Bengaluru, where I currently work on an inventory and order-tracking platform used by about 40 retail partners. Recently I led the migration of one of our services from a monolith to microservices, which brought down average API response time by nearly 35%. I am comfortable with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and AWS, and I have worked closely with QA and support teams to fix production issues quickly.

Since Nexora runs service centres across several cities, I would be keen to contribute to your after-sales and spare parts systems. I hold a B.E. in Computer Science from R V College of Engineering, Bengaluru (2022). My notice period is 60 days, negotiable to 45.

I have attached my resume and would be glad to discuss further at your convenience.

Dear Sir/Madam,

We are pleased to invite Nexora Electronics to participate in our Campus Recruitment Drive for the 2027 graduating batch. Our college is NAAC A+ accredited and this year around 480 students are graduating across Electronics & Communication, Electrical, Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering. body:
Hello Ms. Rane,

Thank you for the offer letter dated 14 Oct 2026 for the position of Digital Marketing Executive (Mumbai). I am very happy with the role and the team I met during the interviews, and I would like to join.

Before I sign, I wanted to discuss a few points on the compensation. The offered CTC is 6.0 LPA, but my current fixed pay at Pixelwave Media is 6.6 LPA plus a variable component. Considering my experience with paid campaigns (Google Ads, Meta) and the SEO work I handled for two electronics brands, I was expecting around 7.5 LPA. Would it be possible to revisit the fixed component? Even 7.0 LPA would work for me.

Second, my notice period is 60 days. My current manager has agreed verbally to release me in 45 days, which I will confirm in writing. Could the joining date be set to 7 Dec 2026 instead of 16 Nov?

Lastly, could you please clarify whether the joining bonus mentioned during our call is part of the CTC or separate, and whether the health insurance covers parents.

I look forward to your reply.

subject: Need to speak to someone - confidential
body:
Hello,

I am writing because I don't know who else to approach and I would really appreciate some guidance. I work as a Service Coordinator at the Pune service centre and have been with Nexora for about 2 years.

For the last 3-4 months my reporting manager, Mr. Sachin Pawar, has been raising his voice at me in front of the entire team during the daily review calls. Last Tuesday he called my work 'useless' when a customer's AC parts were delayed, though the delay was from the warehouse side. I have also noticed that Saturday duties are given to me and two other juniors almost every week while others are rarely rostered. When I asked politely about rotation, he said I should be grateful to have the job.

I don't want to make this a big issue and I am not looking to file anything formal right now. I just want to understand what the process is for raising such concerns confidentially, and whether it is possible to have a conversation with someone senior, or maybe a transfer to the Hyderabad centre in future.

Please keep this between us for now. My colleague Neelam has faced similar behaviour, but she does not know I am writing this. I can share more details when we speak.

Thank you for your time.

Ishaan Bhatia
Service Coordinator, Pune
+91 97650 28431
